fact: The 2025/26 report states the SARB regulates, supervises and oversees the NPS, oversees PayInc (ex-BankservAfrica), SAMOS and the SADC-RTGS as systemic FMIs, exercised oversight of PayShap (14 participating banks) and completed its 50% PayInc acquisition on 5 November 2025.
title: National Payment System Regulatory and Oversight Report 2025/26 (1 April 2025 - 31 March 2026)
